gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan keeps its curves apart, the tips never quite touching, and the tall x-height makes it feel modern. Noto Sans Avestan against Mystery Quest's bookish, nostalgic jaws is where the pair is strongest: old-fashioned charm on top, crisp clarity below.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Noto Sans Balinese has a modern, businesslike look, with short ascenders and space inside every curve. Mystery Quest sets a nostalgic, bookish tone with open-jawed curves and compact ascenders, and the body text quietly takes over from there.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum feels modern and clean, its curved strokes stopping short before they turn inward. And over a longer stretch, the big open counters let the text move along easily beneath Mystery Quest's nostalgic heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Contemporary and businesslike, Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a dominant midsection that swallows most of the line and a c with jaws like pliers. Mystery Quest adds bookish, nostalgic charm above it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-batak: Mystery Quest is the bookish, nostalgic one, with open-jawed curves and compact ascenders that suit a headline. Noto Sans Batak is the workhorse, a plain sans with a towering x-height and an e that never looks squeezed shut.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Open-jawed curves on every round stroke give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic look. Noto Sans Bengali answers with capitals barely taller than lowercase and open letter mouths, and that quiet sameness is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki has swollen, tightly coiled lowercase and open apertures that stay easy to read. Then Mystery Quest comes in above with bookish, nostalgic jaws, and the two feel like an old story told plainly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi sits with a high mean line and an open-ended look on every curved letter, contemporary and neutral. Make Mystery Quest small and its nostalgic jaws get lost.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Modern and open, Noto Sans Buginese has letter mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined, with short ascenders. Noto Sans Buginese gives longer text a steady, easy pace under Mystery Quest's nostalgic heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-buhid: Bookish and nostalgic, Mystery Quest opens every curved stroke into a jaw and tucks its ascenders in tight above tall lowercase. Noto Sans Buhid then carries the text smoothly, with a high x-height and generous gaps at the curve ends.
